python -c "
import semver

# Test replace with various scenarios
print('Testing edge cases:')

# Replace only major
r = semver.replace('1.2.3', major=5)
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3\", major=5) = {repr(r)}')

# Replace only patch
r = semver.replace('1.2.3', patch=9)
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3\", patch=9) = {repr(r)}')

# Replace prerelease and build
r = semver.replace('1.2.3-rc.1+build.1', prerelease='alpha.2', build='final')
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3-rc.1+build.1\", prerelease=\"alpha.2\", build=\"final\") = {repr(r)}')

# VersionInfo.replace edge cases
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, prerelease='rc.1', build='build.1')
new_v = v.replace(major=5, patch=9)
print(f'  VersionInfo.replace(major=5, patch=9): {repr(new_v)}')

# Replace with None should not change that field
new_v2 = v.replace(prerelease=None)  
print(f'  VersionInfo.replace(prerelease=None): {repr(new_v2)}')

# Verify all public names are accessible
print('\nVerifying public API:')
names = ['replace', 'createparser', 'main', 'process']
for name in names:
    assert hasattr(semver, name), f'{name} not found in semver module'
    print(f'  semver.{name}: OK')

# Verify VersionInfo.replace is accessible
assert hasattr(semver.VersionInfo, 'replace'), 'VersionInfo.replace not found'
print('  VersionInfo.replace: OK')

print('\nAll checks passed!')
"
